Streaming chat completion via Azure OpenAI — verifies the azure/ prefix routes correctly and SSE chunks are delivered in the standard OpenAI chat.completion.chunk shape

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"azure/gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"temperature\":0}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chatStream(_req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
